description: The card optimization guide routed categories (flights/hotels, business purchases 5K+, Dell technology, wireless phone, international) to an 'Amex Business Platinum' (amex-biz-plat) that David does not hold and which is not in card-registry.json. David: 'biz platinum is a hallucination you made.' A card that does not exist was used as a routing target in credit-card optimization logic.
correction: Only route to cards present in systems/credit-cards/card-registry.json. Never introduce a card that is not in the registry, and never assign benefits to it from general knowledge of what such a card offers.
root_cause: Fabricated a plausible card and its benefit structure rather than routing only to the cards actually held.
